content.short: Balloon is a protocol that lets users deposit NFTs and earn interest.
content.description: Balloon is a lending protocol for NFTs that lets users deposit their NFTs to earn interest. Borrowers select NFTs with an optimal valuation, collateral requirements, and a loan duration that fits their needs. They pay interest only for the portion of time elapsed relative to the total loan duration. After borrowing an NFT, users can sell it immediately and later buy it back to short NFTs, or return any NFT from the same collection.
